upstream_test_mode: mixed ASGI, filesystem, client, optional integration and service-adjacent tests; not used transparently
collection_policy: Every scenario emits exactly one unique leaf; collection mismatch is fatal.
excluded_reasons: TestClient, WebSocketTestSession and live transport behavior require an HTTP client backend or a broader integration harness.
Multipart, templates, static file delivery and OpenTelemetry require optional dependencies or filesystem/service adaptation outside this deterministic contract.
